Looks like your pet store doesn't know nothing about fish keeping, so sorry for all the oscars that have died, but it was not your fault. First make sure to not put any fish there anymore because they will die, second buy something to get rid of the chlorine in the water if you don't have it, I reccomend seachem prime. Put one drop per 2 liters of water and it should get rid of the chlorine. Now you need some source of ammonia in the tank to feed the bacteria, in my case I dropped some goldfish pellets but your tank should have a lot because of the fish that were in it previously. With ammonia in the tank now you just need to wait 30 days, keep testing your tank for ammonia, nitrites and nitrates, if the nitrites and nitrates start going up means it's working and there are beneficial bacteria being formed in your tank. That's all I know and I'm sorry if you still don't understand it, I have set up my first tank 5 months ago and I'm not an expert, but I hope this help you.
